scope: Real scene duelist gestures from the existing public native protocol projection, applied LP damage, and separately supplied public outcomes
verificationKind: Unit/integration tests with actual avatar geometry and the native message translator; protocol messages in these tests are supplied fixtures, not a running duel

commands.command: node --test --test-isolation=none --test-reporter=spec test/real-duel-avatar-gestures.test.js test/real-duel-attack-negation.test.js test/real-duel-scene-privacy.test.js test/real-duel-scene-render-loop.test.js test/real-duel-pose-routing.test.js test/real-duel-ui.test.js test/duelist-avatar-integration.test.js test/duelist-avatar-models.test.js test/duelist-avatar-gestures.test.js test/native-duel-visual-events.test.js test/native-field-visuals.test.js test/native-summon-visuals.test.js

verified: Success callbacks from SUMMONED and public CHAINING drive the correct owner and anatomical arm joints
Applied lp-loss requires cost:false and damage matching previousLP-lp; cost, recovery and LPUPDATE do not drive damage
Zero, missing or explicitly failed attribute results cannot drive a reaction
Avatar APIs receive only allowlisted gesture names and primitive strength/hold/immediate options; private identity getter guards remain unread
Native summon IDs, attack ID/replay count, and per-Chain link identifiers deduplicate callbacks without merging later genuine commands
Replay replaces the old projectile; matching native negation/stop removes its owned gesture while effect-parent and model gestureId guards preserve newer reactions
A stale native attack ID cannot cancel a newer attack at the same zone
Visibility pauses gesture time; hidden cancellation renders no frame; reduced motion skips transient gestures
Public player/opponent/draw results hold terminal poses synchronously with zero RAF, also when summary update precedes victory callback
LP zero alone does not derive a winner; public surrender winner reaches an inactive view without cloning GameState
Outcome before summary makes a later camera choice immediate instead of freezing an interpolation
Cosmetic replacement keeps the held outcome; owned GPU resources dispose exactly once
limitations: No actual browser duel or visual screenshot is claimed by this report; the separate Oct11 browser audit supplies that evidence
Only existing public face-up combat events can produce transient gestures; concealed/explicitly private events do not
If the duel ends in the same native batch as LP damage, the held terminal outcome takes precedence over transient damage
